note: Bootstrap artifact for harness-execution-redesign-2026-08 Task 1 (Stage 0a, invariant 2). Stage 1 (nl-maintenance.sh, Task 3) is now the REAL reader+writer of this file: it reads `script`/`script_args`/`declared_cadence_seconds` as its job table (completion-anchored -- next run is scheduled only after the previous one's `bash <script> <script_args>` invocation returns, so `declared_cadence_seconds` becomes a MINIMUM floor between completions rather than a wall-clock fixed interval; this satisfies invariant 2 by construction for any entry whose real cycle time exceeds its declared cadence, e.g. coord-sync's proven 60s-declared/110s-measured mismatch). `managed_by` distinguishes entries nl-maintenance.sh actually schedules (`nl-maintenance`) from ones it does not touch (`external`, `standalone`). schema_version 2 adds: `script_args`, `managed_by`, `legacy_task_name` (the schtasks TaskName Stage 0 disabled, null if none/not applicable), `retired_installer_note`.

cadence_check.ratio_floor_meaning: declared_cadence_seconds must be >= ratio_floor x measured_cycle_seconds for every entry that has a non-null measured_cycle_seconds. Entries with measured_cycle_seconds == null are calibration-pending and are skipped (not WARNed) -- absence of a measurement is not itself a violation at this stage.
